mentions.name: Chatterbox Phone
mentions.description: A home phone service built around a landline phone for young children, letting families keep smartphones out of kids' hands while still allowing them to call and communicate with family members.
mentions.problem: Families want to put off the smartphone for as long as possible but still need a way for young kids to communicate by phone.
mentions.audience: Families who want to delay giving their children smartphones while still enabling young kids to communicate with relatives over a landline phone.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building (launched in Feb) a home phone service for families who want to put off the smartphone for as long as possible, but still give young kids the ability to communicate via landline.

evidence.value: I’ve been building (launched in Feb) a home phone service for families who want to put off the smartphone for as long as possible, but still give young kids the ability to communicate via landline.
